# Short #005 - Tatlin's Tower: The Tower That Spun

## Title options (1 = recommended)
1. This Tower Was Designed to Spin. Once a Day.
2. The 400-Metre Spinning Tower That Was Never Built
3. In 1920, They Designed a Tower With Rotating Buildings Inside

## Description
Four hundred metres of iron and glass. Three buildings inside, each turning at its own speed: once a year, once a month, once a day.

Vladimir Tatlin designed the Monument to the Third International in 1919-1920 for Petrograd (now Saint Petersburg). It was never built. This is a concept visualization of what might have been.

Visuals are AI-generated concept art, not photographs or plans of a real structure.
